title: SHIFT(hold) + NUMBER not working to switch between Fancy zones personal layouts

judgment.rationale: The reported Shift+number / number-during-drag regression is covered by an open fork design trace and an upstream draft PR proposing the matching FancyZones change. This is in-progress coverage, not a resolved or merged fix. Later comments also mention separate Explorer zoning/persistence symptoms, which are not covered by that PR.
evidence: The body describes Shift+number failing while dragging in v0.101.2362.0; comments confirm the secondary-button flow, report workarounds, and include later Explorer placement symptoms.
Live fork issue #633 contains an approved design for the same drag-time quick-layout path and identifies FancyZones::OnKeyDown plus the modifier guard.
Upstream draft PR #50695 is open and changes src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesLib/FancyZones.cpp to restore the prior bare-digit drag path; the scope matches the primary symptom.
Focused source inspection shows FancyZones::OnKeyDown requires Win+Ctrl+Alt even while dragging; merged PR #48569 introduced that guard. PR #50695 remains draft and unmerged.
judgment.recommended_action: Reuse the existing fork design and PR #50695; do not create a competing design. Keep unrelated Explorer placement/persistence reports distinct and do not represent them as fixed by this PR.

fix_assessment.rationale: An existing approved fork-side design and an open upstream draft PR target the exact reported FancyZones drag-time layout-switch regression; coverage is pending and limited to that behavior.

issue_context.summary: The original report and several replies describe loss of the earlier number-key layout switch during a FancyZones drag; the discussion also contains separate window-placement complaints.
known_information: The reporter identified PowerToys v0.101.2362.0 and said Shift+number stopped switching personal layouts while moving windows.
Commenters describe the same loss with the non-primary mouse-button drag flow; others report the Win+Ctrl+Alt+number workaround or a Keyboard Manager remapping workaround.
One commenter says downgrading to v0.100.2 restored the shortcut for a period; another says the latest preview still had the problem.
A later comment reports separate Explorer/Obsidian zone-placement and post-restart placement symptoms; those are not the same behavior as the reported drag-time hotkey regression.
Fork issue #633 has an approved design, and upstream PR #50695 remains open as a draft.
inferences: The primary shortcut regression is strongly consistent with the Win+Ctrl+Alt guard added to FancyZones drag-time layout switching.
The open PR is likely to address the primary shortcut symptom, but no merged fix or runtime verification is evidenced; the separate Explorer placement reports may have another cause.
issue_context.analysis: The present source and existing proposal point to the same narrowly scoped FancyZones keyboard condition, so a second design would duplicate active work. The issue discussion has broadened beyond that condition; only the original drag-time shortcut symptom is covered by the existing trace.
initial_investigation: Inspected FancyZonesLib/FancyZones.cpp::FancyZones::OnKeyDown: the drag branch requires Win, Ctrl, Alt, and a digit; the non-drag branch separately retains the modifier shortcut.
Read upstream PR #48569, which introduced the guard while fixing stuck-drag key capture, and open draft PR #50695, which proposes restoring the prior drag behavior.
Read live MuyuanMS/PowerToys issue #633; it already contains an approved design for the same behavior. No matching fork PR was found.
Read the complete current issue body and comments, including reports of additional Explorer placement symptoms; no diagnostic archive was needed for this source-confirmed hotkey path.
